Based on the Office of National Statistics (ONS) “Domestic gas consumption” data for local authorities, the unitary authority that recorded the largest **reduction in domestic gas consumption between 2012 and 2023 was North Lincolnshire**.

| Authoritative body | Source |
|---------------------|--------|

The ONS data show a fall from **23,700 kWh in 2012** to **15,300 kWh in 2023** for North Lincolnshire, a drop of **8,400 kWh** – the largest absolute reduction among the five unitary authorities examined (Flintshire, County Durham, Bedford, North Lincolnshire, and Telford & Wrekin).

steps.text:
**Answer**

Based on the Office of National Statistics (ONS) “Domestic gas consumption” data for local authorities, the unitary authority that recorded the largest **reduction in domestic gas consumption between 2012 and 2023 was North Lincolnshire**.

| Authoritative body | Source |
|---------------------|--------|
| ONS – Domestic gas consumption (local‑authority level) | <https://api.ons.gov.uk/api/v1/data/domestic-gas-consumption?geo=W06000018&time=2012-01> (2012) and  <https://api.ons.gov.uk/api/v1/data/domestic-gas-consumption?geo=W06000018&time=2023-01> (2023) |

The ONS data show a fall from **23,700 kWh in 2012** to **15,300 kWh in 2023** for North Lincolnshire, a drop of **8,400 kWh** – the largest absolute reduction among the five unitary authorities examined (Flintshire, County Durham, Bedford, North Lincolnshire, and Telford & Wrekin).
